title: Retention
description: How long meeting records, transcripts and recordings are kept before they are deleted. Periods can only be shortened here.
appliesText: Day counts apply within about five minutes to new records; a deletion choice applies from the next meeting that ends.

meetingRecordExpirationInDays.title: Days to keep meeting records
meetingRecordExpirationInDays.description: Days a meeting, its summary and usage records are kept, then deleted. At most the stack's MeetingRecordExpirationInDays.

transcriptionExpirationInDays.title: Days to keep transcript segments
transcriptionExpirationInDays.description: Days transcript turns and assistant answers are kept, then deleted. At most the stack's TranscriptionExpirationInDays.

transcriptDeletionAfterSummary.title: Delete the transcript after the summary
transcriptDeletionAfterSummary.description: Permanently delete a meeting's transcript once its summary is written, now or after a delay. The summary and recording are kept.

enumLabels.off: Off (keep for the days set above)

recordingDeletionAfterSummary.title: Delete the recordings after the summary
recordingDeletionAfterSummary.description: Permanently delete a meeting's audio and video recordings once its summary is written, now or after a delay.

enumLabels.off: Off (keep as the stack parameters say)
